acceptance_contract.observable: Each of exactly two rendered circular swatches is visually distinguishable from the card background.
acceptance_contract.forbidden_shortcut: Removing a low-contrast swatch or rendering fewer than two swatches does not pass.
acceptance_contract.threshold_source: Geometric midpoint of the measured separation between the highlighted Before and After PR screenshots.

saved_codex_patch_replay.reason: The patch filters low-contrast palette entries. In both screenshot-derived cases this leaves only one swatch, violating the two-swatch visual contract.

saved_kimi_k3_patch_replay.reason: The patch filters entire style variations by text/background contrast in the parent list, but does not correct the two circular swatches rendered inside a retained card. Hiding a problematic variation is not equivalent to making both swatches distinguishable.

v2_disposition.reason: v2 reused the agent's 3:1 choice and added fallback colors after observing the patch, so its Codex pass cannot support an unbiased model-quality claim.
